name: Can I assess wind damage to my roof myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I assess wind damage to my roof myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While you can visually check your roof for obvious signs of damage from the ground, a professional evaluation is recommended for a complete and safe assessment. Roofing professionals have the experience, training, and safety equipment to identify subtle damage, assess structural integrity, and provide a comprehensive report without risking personal injury. Attempting a self-assessment may lead to overlooking critical damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can check for obvious damage from the ground, but a professional evaluation is safer and more thorough for a complete assessment.
